shows: Jamestown has no source of its own: its 2025 surface and ground water supply are 0.0000 MGD, and it lists no treatment plant. It buys from Greensboro (0.0983 MGD average daily, contract 0.1250 MGD), from High Point (0.4330 MGD, contract 1.5000 MGD) and from PTRWA (0.0000 MGD, contract 0.1500 MGD to 2057), each on 365 days. The note says that most of its water is PTRWA water routed through the lines of Greensboro and High Point. It routes 0.500 MGD through High Point and 0.125 MGD through Greensboro, and a separate 1.0 MGD contract with High Point covers any additional need. The purchases sum to 0.5313 MGD (derived), equal to its total demand.
limits: Self-reported data. Contract amounts are agreed volumes, not the hydraulic capacity of the connections. The 0.1500 MGD PTRWA contract is the rest of the town's 0.775 MGD PTRWA allocation, not a separate connection, and no water came through it in 2025. The sellers report different 2025 volumes: High Point lists 0.3550 MGD and Greensboro 0.1055 MGD of sales to Jamestown.
